newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells shares in three smaller firms.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells shares in three smaller firms.

text.p: Croatia's privatisation agency sold 1.2 million kuna worth of shares in three smaller firms at an auction on Thursday, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported.
* a block of 1,181 shares or 8.56 percent of cattle breeder Stocar d.d. Zupanja at a face value of 842,218 kuna to Investco brokers.
* a 27.6-percent package in researcher Prometis d.o.o for 278,548 kuna to Ceufin brokers.
* total stock of engineers Geoprojekt consisting of 354 shares for a total of 126,225 kuna at their nominal price (100 German marks each) to Consult Invest brokerage.
The agency recently approved a 30-percent cut on sell prices for cash payments in a bid to sell the state's tiny holdings in mostly privatised firms.
But the interest for remaining assets in its portfolio has waned since the most attractive firms went, some at a discount for public debt bonds. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
